title: Probe into intentional start of Fontainebleau fire underway
summary: French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said authorities were exploring the possibility that the fire in the Fontainebleau forest, south of Paris, was intentionally started. This comes as France is weathering a third heatwave in less than three months, with fires raging in several parts of the country over the past week. FRANCE 24's Elitsa Gadeva tells us mo…
